remarks: This fantastic 2-bedroom 2 full bath condo is in the heart of vibrant Norwalk yet feels miles from it all. Rolling Ridge is a bucolic condominium community built in what feels like a nature preserve. At the center of the complex is a scenic pond with rock outcroppings and is visible from this top floor unit. Sit out on your deck and enjoy your morning coffee in a peaceful tranquil setting - every day. This spacious unit has a large open living room / dining room area which opens to the deck. The kitchen is extremely efficient, with lots of storage and granite countertops. The primary bedroom has a full bath with tiled shower and double closets. A second spacious bedroom utilizes the full bath in the common hallway. There is a washer/dryer in the unit and an additional storage unit in an adjacent building. The complex offers an in-ground pool and paddle tennis courts overlooking the pond. Plenty of open parking and low common charges that include heat and hot water. Enjoy the convenience and beauty of this wonderful community and home!
